title: Turing-profile-v1.0 terminal receipt
description: final_receipt.json written instead of the normal measurement receipt in two cases (calibration/docs/FAILURE_REPORTING.md section 2): kind terminal_fail = a check failed that ends the run with verdict FAIL (written by turing-cal-eval run or gate; the failing criterion FAIL, every other NOT_REACHED, which counts as FAIL); kind inconclusive_infra = the third VOID attempt of EXP-001, counted over generation, frozen-tree tests and evaluation together (verdict INCONCLUSIVE, reason INFRA; written by whichever of turing-cal-eval, generate_sealed_data.sh or record_void.sh wrote the third void receipt). Written once, exclusive create, never replaced, in <eval root>/<C_f>/run/bundle.

criteria.description: terminal_fail only: S1-S9, each FAIL or NOT_REACHED

failed_criterion.description: terminal_fail only: S1 (coder or decoder failure), S2 (freeze-order violation, sealed mode), S3 (stream, serialization, binding or symbol-stream failure), S4 (per-crumb sum mismatch), S6 (group 1 has no crumbs), S8 (lane D file missing, unreadable, unparsable; written by the gate), S9 (group 2 has no crumbs), or NONE (read or write failure after scoring that belongs to no single criterion: every criterion NOT_REACHED). S5 and S7 are judged only in the full measurement receipt. EVALUATOR.md section 3 maps every code.

profile_digest.description: SHA-256 of the profile the run read (gate: copied from the pending receipt)

freeze_commit.description: C_f; DRY_RUN in a development dry run
